q_hi:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Excite
solution:
Solution (EN): 'Excite' means to cause strong feelings of enthusiasm and eagerness. 'Thrill' is the most appropriate synonym as it means a sudden feeling of excitement and pleasure.
Solution (HI): 'Excite' का अर्थ है उत्साह या उत्तेजना पैदा करना। 'Thrill' इसका सबसे उपयुक्त पर्यायवाची है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ अचानक होने वाला उत्साह या आनंद है।
Short Trick: Think of 'Exciting' things as 'Thrilling' experiences.

q_en: To 'untie the Gordian knot' suggests an approach to problem-solving that is: 228
q_hi: To 'untie the Gordian knot' suggests an approach to problem-solving that is: 228
solution:
Solution (EN): The idiom 'untie/cut the Gordian knot' refers to solving an extremely complex problem by using a bold, unconventional, and decisive method.
Solution (HI): मुहावरे 'untie the Gordian knot' का अर्थ है किसी बहुत ही जटिल समस्या को साहसिक, अपरंपरागत और निर्णायक तरीके से हल करना।
Short Trick: Knot = Complex Problem; Untying/Cutting it = Quick/Bold solution.

q_en: Which of the following options is closest to the meaning of the word 'uxorious'?221
q_hi: Which of the following options is closest to the meaning of the word 'uxorious'?221
solution:
Solution (EN): 'Uxorious' describes a man who is excessively fond of or submissive to his wife. Among the options, 'Devoted' is the closest in meaning.
Solution (HI): 'Uxorious' का अर्थ है वह पति जो अपनी पत्नी के प्रति अत्यधिक समर्पित या उसकी हर बात मानने वाला हो। दिए गए विकल्पों में 'Devoted' (समर्पित) सबसे सटीक है।
Short Trick: Latin root 'Uxor' = Wife. Uxorious = Excessive love for wife.

solution:
Solution (EN): The word 'prone' means likely or liable to suffer from, do, or experience something unpleasant. The phrase 'prone to natural disasters' is contextually correct.
Solution (HI): 'Prone' का अर्थ है किसी अप्रिय चीज़ (जैसे प्राकृतिक आपदा) का अनुभव करने या उससे पीड़ित होने की संभावना होना। 'Prone to disasters' यहाँ सही वाक्यांश है।
Short Trick: Subject + be + prone to + negative event (e.g., accidents/disasters).

q_en:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the paragraph given below.

He had been in service before he was appointed to his eclesiatical office, but only in very good houses, and his deportment was irreproachable. Starting as a page boy in the household of a merchant prince, he had risen by due degrees from the position of fourth to first footman.326
q_hi:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the paragraph given below.

He had been in service before he was appointed to his eclesiatical office, but only in very good houses, and his deportment was irreproachable. Starting as a page boy in the household of a merchant prince, he had risen by due degrees from the position of fourth to first footman.326
solution:
Solution (EN): The incorrectly spelt word is 'eclesiatical'. The correct spelling is 'ecclesiastical', which means relating to the Christian Church or its clergy.
Solution (HI): 'eclesiatical' की वर्तनी गलत है। सही वर्तनी 'ecclesiastical' (पादरी या चर्च संबंधी) है।
Short Trick: Break it down: EC-CLES-I-AS-TI-CAL (Double C and Double S).
